name: Wizalign
storyline:
Embark on an epic adventure where every battle, treasure, dungeon, and discovery unfolds through addictive match-3 gameplay.

Explore a vibrant fantasy world filled with menacing monsters, terrific treasures, dark dungeons, auspicious artifacts, and big bad bosses. Match your way through the land as you fight enemies, collect keys, uncover rare rewards, and grow stronger with every move.

Wizalign combines the satisfying puzzle-solving of classic "Match 3" games with the progression, exploration, and item discovery of a retro adventure RPG. Every level is a strategic battlefield where attacking, healing, defending, and collecting must all be kept in balance.

Will you focus on defeating the monsters? Collect keys to advance? Chase valuable treasure? Or risk everything to claim a powerful new item hidden deep within a dungeon?

Every move is a meaningful choice.
summary: A match-3 adventure RPG where every action happens on the puzzle board. Battle monsters, collect keys, discover powerful dungeon items, manage health and shields, and defeat bosses as you explore overworlds and dungeons inspired by classic adventure games.
